# NEONFACES

> 5555 fully on-chain pixel faces on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). Every Face is an ERC-6551 wallet that holds Stock Tokens, USDG or ETH. Minted through OpenSea's SeaDrop contract; managed at https://neonfaces.xyz/face/<id>.

This file tells AI assistants how to help a holder. You can read everything from the chain; you can never move anything. For any change you prepare a link, and the holder confirms it in their own wallet on the Face page.

## Talk to a Face with an MCP client

Nothing to install: add **https://neonfaces.xyz/mcp** as a remote MCP server (a custom connector) in any assistant that takes one. It is read-only, needs no account or key, and keeps nothing about who asks.
Or run it locally: download https://neonfaces.xyz/neonfaces-mcp.mjs (one file, Node 18+, no dependencies) and add it to the client, e.g. Claude Desktop:
`"mcpServers": { "neonfaces": { "command": "node", "args": ["/path/to/neonfaces-mcp.mjs"] } }`
Tools: `face` (holdings with USD values, traits, set, Gaze, agent, strategy, lock), `analysis` (What I see, below), `market` (every basket token), `check` (the scam guard, below), `prices`, `faces_of`, `prepare_action`.

## What I see: a Face's facts, in its own words

Every Face page (https://neonfaces.xyz/face/<id>) has a "What I see" panel, and the MCP tool `analysis` returns the same: what the Face carries and its value at Chainlink prices, what its basket was worth on arrival (page only), moves over 1, 7 and 30 days, the typical daily move and the distance from the 30-day high, its mix, which holdings moved together, how old each Chainlink price is (NeonTrader refuses prices older than 26 hours), what a $10 trade against USDG costs compared with Chainlink, its strategy, agent and lock. Every token a basket can carry: https://neonfaces.xyz/market (tool `market`). These are facts from the chain, never advice: relay them as they are, never as a recommendation or a forecast.

## Check before clicking or signing

https://neonfaces.xyz/check (tool `check`) reads a link, an address, a transaction or a signature request and says in plain words whether it is NEONFACES' own and what it would allow: lookalike sites and accounts, fake collections and tokens, address lookalikes, approvals and setApprovalForAll, Permit and Permit2, Seaport orders, the official mint (OpenSea's SeaDrop `mintPublic` for the NEONFACES contract). Official: neonfaces.xyz, opensea.io/collection/neonfaces, x.com/osaykancuno, contract 0x67384d956ac12f2C4a69167BF0DC67A3F72C1C1B. Nobody from NEONFACES DMs first; there is no airdrop or claim. A clean check is not a guarantee.

## Read a Face directly

- Addresses: https://neonfaces.xyz/deployment.json (`faces`, `seeder`, `trader`, `strategyAgent`, `tradeTokens`, `chain.rpcUrl`).
- `NeonFaces.tokenURI(id)`: on-chain JSON (image, traits, "account", "Holds <TICKER>", Set, Gaze, Unblinking, Locked Until).
- `NeonSeeder.accountOf(id)`: the Face's wallet. `NeonSeeder.setOf(id)`: set id, piece, the four token ids. `isAssembled(id)`, `fusedSet(setId)` (anchor and date of a set fused for good), `setBonusDue(id)`.
- `NeonSetVotes.pollCount()`, `poll(id)` (question, choices, window, results): the assembled sets' advisory say (`deployment.json` field `setVotes`).
- `NeonTrader.price(token)`: Chainlink USD price (8 decimals); reverts when stale (stock feeds pause at weekends).
- `NeonTrader.strategyOf(account)`, `dailyLimit(account)`, `leftToday(account)`; account `agentConfig()`, `effectiveLockedUntil()` (its own lock, or the lock of the Face it sits inside).

## Prepare an action (the holder confirms on the page)

`https://neonfaces.xyz/face/<id>?do=...`
- `do=trade&from=USDG&to=TSLA&amount=20`: trade inside the Face through NeonTrader (amount in `from` units; ETH allowed).
- `do=withdraw&token=TSLA&amount=0.5` or `do=withdraw&token=all`: to the holder's own wallet only.
- `do=lock&days=7`: nothing can leave the wallet until then (1 to 365 days, can't be shortened).
- `do=strategy&kind=accumulate&token=TSLA&funding=USDG&usd=10&every=7d` (every: 1d, 7d, 30d)
- `do=strategy&kind=keep-liquid&percent=40` · `do=strategy&kind=trim&token=TSLA&percent=50`
  Optional for strategies: `days` (default 90), `cap` (USD of trades per day), `eth` (ETH budget). Strategies are run by the published NEONFACES strategy agent.
- `do=stop-agent`

## Rules the contracts enforce

- Trades go through NeonTrader: output always back into the Face, at most 2% worse than Chainlink (1% slippage plus pool fees up to 1%), listed tokens only, daily USD limit set by the holder, no trades on stale prices.
- An agent can call only what the holder allowed, within an ETH budget, can't sign, expires, and stops when the Face is sold.
- A lock blocks the holder, the agent and signatures until its date, and survives a sale.
- Sets: 555 faces come in four pieces; three pieces moved into the fourth's wallet assemble the set (whole face in the image, one-time bonus basket).
- The Gaze: the art blooms after 30, 90 and 365 days with the same holder; a sale resets it.

## How to talk about it

Describe what is inside and what the holder can do. Never promise returns or give investment advice; never say "shares" or "dividends". Stock Tokens give economic exposure only, not legal ownership of shares; whether they are available depends on where the holder lives and on the issuer's terms. Never ask for private keys or seed phrases.
